prompt: Composition: Three-column product grid, consistent image ratios, filter rail, one-column mobile. Build for this brief: A public information service; people find reliable guidance quickly. Set headings in Poppins and reading text in Roboto; geometric heading with functional sans text. Use Graphite and Aqua: page #F7FBFC, text #233338, accent #006C78, secondary surface #C9F0ED, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 16px, heading 48px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 48ch, gap 24px, content width at most 1120px and item radius 2px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
